answer: Each new agent locks a small stake in a time-locked vault and must answer one seeded challenge per epoch, graded by three randomly drawn established peers. Rewards unlock only after six passing epochs, so a farm of 1,000 sybils freezes 1,000 stakes for 36 hours and must produce 6,000 original answers; any near-duplicate slashes every linked stake. Build reputation like basalt, not opal: dull, heavy and costly to fake, never shiny and cheap.
